question: Which Linux companion app track should OpenClaw pursue as the canonical path for this umbrella now that Windows Hub is shipped?
rationale: The remaining work is a broad desktop product/security decision with competing open GTK/C and Rust/GTK4 candidates, not a narrow repair that automation can choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor one Linux GTK track
options.body: Choose the preferred Linux implementation track, require focused packaging/security/proof milestones, and close or redirect the alternative once its useful ideas are preserved.

options.title: Split into platform milestones
options.body: Keep this umbrella open only for tracking and create narrower Linux packaging, pairing, chat, tray, and desktop-capability milestones before accepting either large PR.

options.title: Defer Linux app work
options.body: Close or pause the active Linux app candidates until core security/setup priorities have capacity, while keeping docs explicit that Linux uses the Gateway path today.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one Linux GTK track
recommendation.body: Choose the preferred Linux implementation track, require focused packaging/security/proof milestones, and close or redirect the alternative once its useful ideas are preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the issue, gave the clearest product-direction comments, and appears in recent platform/app history.
